title: Salty Sample Derivatization Protocol for GC-MS
author: Emilia Sogin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nyxdfxn
materials: Ultrasonicate the derivatized sample for 10 min
Samples can be stored at 4°C until derivatization.

steps.title: Dry Salty Sample
steps.instruction: Dry 0.5 to 1 ml of a salty sample using an eppendorf Concentrator plus SpeedVac at 45 °C in V-AQ mode for 6 hours.

substeps.instruction: Ensure drying takes no longer than 6h to prevent sample degradation
Samples may be kept in SpeedVac overnight after the run

steps.title: Remove Solvent and Dissolve Salt
steps.instruction: Remove solvent and prepare the sample for pyridine addition.

substeps.instruction: Ultrasonicate the sample for 10 min at 100% efficiency in a sonication bath
Remove solvent under a steady flow of N2 gas using a 3-D printed drying device with attached needles
Ensure needles are pre-cleaned with organic solvent
Regulate gas flow so only the surface of the solvent is disturbed and needles do not touch the solvent

steps.title: Perform Methoxyamine Derivatization
steps.instruction: Add Methoxyamine (MeOx) to the dried sample and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL of Methoxyamine (MeOx; 20 mg/1 mL of pyridine) to the dried sample
Vortex the sample to dissolve salt crystals into the pyridine solvent until a milky white solution is created
Ultrasonicate for 10 min using a room temperature bath
Incubate the sample at 37 °C for 90 minutes at 1350 r.p.m. using a thermomixer

steps.title: Remove Pyridine Solvent
steps.instruction: Remove the pyridine solvent to leave behind salt crystals.

substeps.instruction: Remove solvent under a steady flow of N2 gas
Use a thermomixer to maintain a constant temperature of 25 °C and rotational speed of 200 r.p.m.

steps.title: Perform BSTFA Derivatization
steps.instruction: Add BSTFA to the salt pellet and process.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μL of N,O-Bis(trimethylsilyl)trifluoroacetamide (BSTFA) to the salt pellet
Keep tubes closed to avoid moisture from the air
Ultrasonicate for 10 min using an ultrasonication bath at room temperature
Centrifuge for 2 min at 14,800 rpm to pellet the salt

steps.title: Final Extraction and Analysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sample and prepare for GC-MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the sample in 250 µL of anhydrous toluene
Incubate the sample at 37 °C for 30 min at 1350 r.p.m. using a thermomixer
Transfer 100 µL of the clear supernatant into a GC-MS vial insert and place on autosample
Run the samples within 1 day after preparation to prevent degradation and MeOX crystallization
